verdict: Clean but for one word: the Wood's crown. Cleared with four stars and no fall, no console error, every spot reachable in both states of the paths; Ash and Ember (the Raid's twin bosses, their own models, in the Cinder Court) fell on the first try; the rival (Anka), the trial and the gate (Tempo) all played.
